China Carbon Sinks Holdings Limited donated and retired 201 tonnes of VCS forest carbon sink credits(VCUs) from Fujian Yong’an Improved Forest Management Project(VCS ID:1577) to neutralize 201 tons of carbon emissions from the conference, so as to achieve the goal of carbon neutral conference. Beijing Institute of Green Resources (BIGR)  March 2023

To offset the carbon emissions from this forum, 60 metric tons of VCS carbon credits from the Fujian Yong'an Improved Forest Management Project (VCS ID: 1577), donated by China Carbon Sinks Holdings Limited (CCSHL), were retired, achieving carbon neutrality for the Fifth National Forestry University Presidents' Forum and fulfilling the goal of a carbon-neutral conference. Beijing Institute of Green Resources (BIGR), September 2023
